title: Bridge
description: The envelope every message between devices travels in, and the expiry rules (SPEC-08, docs/device-bridge.md). The crypto is described in protocol/docs/crypto.md.

Envelope.description: One message between two paired devices. The relay reads only id, from, to, type, expiresAt, and protocolVersion (SPEC-08 r3). Everything that says what the message means is inside the encrypted payload.

id.description: Unique message id. The receiver runs each id at most once (SPEC-08 r8).

replyTo.description: The id of the command this result answers. Required on a result.

expiresAt.description: After this time the message is never delivered or run (SPEC-08 r6).

EnvelopeType.description: The relay never holds a command for an offline device, and holds results and events through a short reconnect (SPEC-08 r7).

Signature.description: An Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) in standard base64 with padding.

SealedPayload.description: The 24-byte nonce followed by the XChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext and tag, in standard base64 with padding. At most 1 MiB of base64 text.

Key32.description: 32 bytes in standard base64 with padding: a public key, a pairing secret, a challenge nonce, or a pairing tag.

DeviceName.description: The name the other device shows, for example "Paired with Jepoy's MacBook Pro".

PairingOffer.description: What the Mac's pairing QR code holds, as JSON text (SPEC-08 r1). The secret is used once and never sent to the relay. See protocol/docs/pairing.md.

pairingSecret.description: 32 random bytes, used once, that key the pairing request's tag.

expiresAt.description: 5 minutes after the code is shown.

PairRequest.description: The phone's keys, sent to the Mac after scanning the QR code.

tag.description: Keyed BLAKE2b-256 with the pairing secret, so the relay cannot swap in its own keys.

PairAccept.description: The Mac's answer to a pairing request.

signature.description: Ed25519 by the Mac's key from the QR code, over the phone's keys.

BridgeFrame.description: One WebSocket text frame between a device and the relay. Each frame says who sends it. See protocol/docs/pairing.md.

ChallengeFrame.description: Relay to device, first frame on every connection.

nonce.description: 32 random bytes, new for every connection.

AuthenticateFrame.description: Device to relay, the answer to the challenge. The relay registers a new device id on first use, and accepts it only if the id is derived from this key.

signature.description: Ed25519 over the challenge nonce and the device id.

ReadyFrame.description: Relay to device: authenticated. Held results, events, and notices follow, oldest first.

RefusedFrame.description: Relay to device: the connection is refused and will close.

EnvelopeFrame.description: Either way: a message for another device. The relay reads only the routing fields.

AckFrame.description: Either way: "I have this message now." The relay acks what it accepted from a sender; a device acks what it received, and the relay then deletes it.

TargetOfflineFrame.description: Relay to sender: a command's target is offline, so it was dropped, never queued (SPEC-08 r7).

ExpiredFrame.description: Relay to sender: a message expired before it could be delivered, and was dropped (SPEC-08 r6).

NotPairedFrame.description: Relay to sender: the sender and the target are not paired, so the message was dropped.

PairRequestFrame.description: Phone to relay to Mac, after scanning the QR code. The relay checks that from is the authenticated sender and forwards the frame unchanged.

PairAcceptFrame.description: Mac to relay to phone. When the relay forwards it after a matching pairRequest, it records the two devices as paired.

UnpairFrame.description: Either device to relay to the other (SPEC-08 r9). The relay removes the pairing at once, then forwards the frame.

CommandExpirySeconds.description: Every command expires 2 minutes after it is sent (SPEC-08 r6, SPEC-09 r16), except an approval request.

ApprovalRequestExpirySeconds.description: An approval request waits 5 minutes; then the task pauses (SPEC-09 r10).

ResultExpirySeconds.description: A result is held for a device that dropped off for 2 minutes (SPEC-08 r7).

EventExpirySeconds.description: An event is held for a device that dropped off for 2 minutes (SPEC-08 r7).
